headline: Britannia's moongates now land at shrines
lede: The eight virtue-gates of BRITANNIA no longer dump the pilgrim at a bare star: each destination is a named chapel with its stone keeper, and the stone is real — walk into it and the shrine answers you back.

notes.text: shrines.js plots one consecrated plot per gate — cardinal, seeded, exactly two paces out, so a chapel can never block the gate it serves; canonical Ultima IV keepers (Dracmato, Ires, Emoj, Dactio, Naergius, Agdash, Gordam, Andros) align index-for-index with the virtue-moons the menu already spoke.

the chapel is stone: the foot refuses the sanctum with a thud and a name — `The Shrine of Sacrifice is stone — about face.` — while ships, warps and gates keep their old law; the arrival toast now carries shrine + keeper, and the compass points `to Spirituality` instead of `to VIII`.

britanniacheck +18 gates (plot/distance/ring/ground laws, 40× determinism, wall-BFS proving stone strands nobody) and the drive 42/42 with panel-vs-Node plot parity; both new mutants die and the tree restores clean. One lesson banked: check `gh pr list` before declaring a lane dead — a deleted branch is usually a merged one.
